on_client_changed (apps/backend-rag/backend/services/events/handlers/_core.py:89-165) fires the following on each replayed row. Critically, the handler does NOT branch on payload['_replay'] (grep proves _replay is read only by federation_alerts/daemon.py + tests, NEVER by _core.py) — so a replayed event is treated identically to a live one and every side-effect fires.

(1) DOUBLE BRIDGE-OUTBOX ROW (the principal disaster). _core.py:124-133 calls insert_outbox_event(conn, 'crm.client_created', ...). bridge_outbox (services/bridge/outbox.py:58-70 + DDL 107_bridge_outbox.sql:23-32) has ZERO idempotency: id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY + non-unique indexes only, plain INSERT, no ON CONFLICT, no idempotency key. Every replayed INSERT writes a FRESH bridge_outbox row with a NEW id ABOVE the Pro's current cursor, so the Pro WILL re-pull and re-process each one. (2) DUPLICATE DRIVE FOLDER (conditional). _core.py:151-154 spawns _create_drive_folder, which guards on clients.drive_folder_id (_core.py:431-438) before drive_svc.create_folder(). (3) DUPLICATE CRM INTERACTION TIMELINE ROW. _core.py:156-164 spawns _log_interaction which does a plain INSERT INTO interactions (...) with no dedup/unique key (_core.py:453-474). Replay adds a second 'Client created — auto-provisioning started' timeline row per client.

channels.idempotency_assessment: PARTIAL / consumer is NOT idempotent on _outbox_id for its external side-effects. on_client_changed has only a 10-second in-process monotonic-clock dedup (_is_duplicate, key 'client:{id}:{op}', _core.py:36-46,102-104) — this is a no-op cold cache after a restart and across the ~9-16 day backlog (every row has a distinct effective dedup window), so it provides ZERO protection during a bulk replay. The handler NEVER reads payload['_outbox_id'] and NEVER reads payload['_replay'] to suppress side-effects. The downstream sink bridge_outbox has NO unique constraint / NO ON CONFLICT / NO idempotency key (107_bridge_outbox.sql:23-32) and the Pro consumer advances a pure monotonic id cursor, so re-emitted rows are guaranteed re-pulled. _log_interaction INSERT has no natural-key dedup. _create_drive_folder is idempotent ONLY if clients.drive_folder_id (the legacy column, not google_drive_folder_id) is already populated for that client — which is NOT guaranteed. Net: replay is at-least-once at the outbox layer but the handler's external effects are NOT idempotent => replay double-fires UNLESS the W36 stale-payload guard short-circuits it. Idempotency is therefore NOT proven from code; default-to-UNSAFE for any drain path that bypasses or disables the W36 'ts'-based stale guard.
